title: Finishing a run on your own terms
target: How to end a R.E.P.O. run deliberately, using the truck and the end-of-run states the game already defines instead of drifting until something goes wrong.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: Loot already carried to the extraction point
A way to call the crew back
Enough health left to reach the truck

steps.do: Decide how much you are hauling before you call the run, not while standing in the doorway.
steps.because: the game separates an ending where not enough was hauled from one where enough was (TruckScreenPage)

steps.do: Walk your own loot in rather than leaving it for someone else to carry.
steps.because: progress toward the extraction point is tracked for each player (ExtractionPointTracking)

steps.do: Call everyone back before the last load, so nobody is caught outside.
steps.because: one of the endings is that every player is aboard the truck (TruckScreenPage)

steps.do: Use the truck to recover before you spend the takings.
steps.because: the truck carries a healer of its own (TruckHealer)

steps.do: Treat the doors opening as the moment the run is over, and stop exploring.
steps.because: the truck doors are a staged part of the ending (TruckDoor)

commonMistakes: Hauling one more valuable after the crew has already called the run.
Leaving your own loot for someone else to carry in.
Spending the takings before anyone has healed.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
